summary: Lakshya, Founder of Laksha Labs (fintech startup). Receiving 800–2,000 inbound leads per month across phone, WhatsApp, and website. Missing leads after business hours ahead of product launch in ~6 weeks. No in-house technical lead; wants end-to-end ownership. Conversion rate 30–40%, revenue per converted customer $10–12. Clear ROI case for 24/7 Voice AI + WhatsApp/web automation before launch. Recommended next step: rapid scoping session to define flows and integrations and lock timeline for pre-launch deployment.
